report: BFF-AUTH-1 landed clean: a single per-request FastAPI middleware (registered right after the CORS block) gates the BFF behind LITHRIM_BFF_TOKEN. Default-OFF is byte-transparent — the token is read per request via _bff_auth_token(), so with it unset everything passes exactly as today (the existing tests/bff/* 111-pass suite confirms the non-regression). ON requires Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key, hmac.compare_digest constant-time; /health + OPTIONS always pass. Tests-first RED->GREEN (3/8 genuinely RED for absent reject-behavior, then 8/8 green); full bare-CE 706 passed/0 failed, ruff clean, vitest only the pre-existing foreign app.test.jsx fail. Moat diff empty; apps/shell/src/app.jsx (foreign, modified) was NOT staged; commit scope is exactly the 4 intended files. The shell change (VITE_BFF_TOKEN -> Bearer in call() + chatStream) is header-only and not browser-observable when the token is unset (the local default), so it was verified via vitest rather than the preview.
